title: What Really Happened to D.B. Cooper?

old.title: He Jumped From a Jet With $200,000 and Vanished
old.description:
On the night before Thanksgiving 1971, a man hijacked a passenger jet, collected $200,000 and jumped out over the forests of Washington. He was never seen again.
So who was "D.B. Cooper," and what really happened after he jumped? The evidence points to an answer most people never hear.

CHAPTERS
0:00 He jumped and vanished
0:33 The Passenger
1:24 The Note
2:37 Seattle
3:41 The Jump
4:38 The Manhunt
5:34 The River
6:25 The Suspects
7:16 The Tie
7:53 The Parachute in the Shed
8:28 The Real Answer

Sources: FBI, "A Byte Out of History: D.B. Cooper" (2006) and NORJAK case updates (2016); Britannica, "D.B. Cooper"; HistoryLink.org essay on the Cooper hijacking; History.com, "Who Was D.B. Cooper?"; Biography.com; The Week, "The legend of D.B. Cooper"; NBC News (2017) on the Citizen Sleuths tie analysis; Hackaday (2024) on the tie particles; Cowboy State Daily (Feb 2026) on the McCoy parachute returned by the FBI; Axios Seattle (Nov 2024).
All visuals are original cartoon illustrations made in code; people are generic characters, and scenes, maps, notes and front pages are illustrative reconstructions, not archival material. Theories are labeled as theories. Narration uses an AI voice.

#DBCooper #UnsolvedMysteries #TrueCrime #FBI #AmericanHistory

title: Did King Tut's Curse Really Kill Carnarvon?

old.title: He Opened King Tut's Tomb and Died Within Months
old.description:
In 1923, the man who paid to open King Tut's tomb was dead within months, and the newspapers called it a curse.
But the man who actually broke into the tomb lived 16 more years. So what really happened? The answer is at the end.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Dead within months
0:39 The last season
1:45 Wonderful things
3:27 Death in Cairo
4:27 How to build a curse
5:47 The survivors
6:51 The real answer

Sources: Nelson MR, "The mummy's curse: historical cohort study", BMJ 2002; University of Manchester (Joyce Tyldesley), 2013; Britannica (Howard Carter); History Today, "Tutankhamun's Curse?"; National Geographic, 2005; Penn Engineering / Nature Chemical Biology, 2025 (asperigimycins).
All visuals are original illustrations drawn in code; scenes are illustrative reconstructions, not archival footage. Narration uses an AI voice.

title: What Really Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke?

old.title: 115 People Vanished and Left Only One Word
old.description:
In 1590, John White came back to find his entire colony gone: more than 100 people, including his granddaughter. All that was left was one word carved into a post.
So what happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? The real answer is at the end.

CHAPTERS
0:00 One word on a post
0:32 The Colony
2:02 The War
3:11 The Return
5:24 The Theories
6:20 The Hidden Map
7:10 The Word On The Post
8:31 The Real Answer

Sources: National Park Service, Fort Raleigh National Historic Site (1590 Voyage; Major Theories of the Lost Colony); History.com, "What Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke?"; National Geographic (2015, 2020); Stahle et al., Science, 1998 (Lost Colony and Jamestown droughts); John Lawson, A New Voyage to Carolina (1709); Popular Archaeology, "Lost and Found: The Evidence for the Lost Colony".
All visuals are original illustrations made in code; scenes and maps are illustrative reconstructions, not archival footage. Narration uses an AI voice.

#LostColony #Roanoke #UnsolvedMysteries #AmericanHistory #Croatoan
